title: The Crest

victory.note: The Russians win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Germans win.

situation: Hill country with woods and a few buildings. The defenders hold a stone building at the east end. The Russians attack with 6 squads under 2 leaders, 3 support weapons, and 1 armored vehicle. The Germans hold with 4 squads under 1 leader, 3 support weapons, and 1 armored vehicle. The Russians win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Germans win. The Russians move first. 7 turns.
